question: What does the completed Japan Monetary Constitution establish about cryptoassets, stablecoins, tokenized deposits, CBDC, domestic and cross-border rails, finality and loss?
bluf: Japan's digital-money record is a layered extension of incumbent legal claims rather than a new sovereign-money successor. The FSA's 30 September On-Chain Finance Forum adds a national roadmap process covering stablecoins, tokenized deposits, wallets, DEX/DeFi, JGBs and possible on-chain use of Bank of Japan current-account money, while a fourth PIP project links future three-megabank stablecoin payments to trade documents. These are coordination and experiment clocks, not production settlement. XRP Asia's 3 October launch adds Tokyo as a regional XRPL community node, but it is separate from the older SBI Ripple Asia joint venture and changes no Japanese licence, product or settlement state. JPYSC remains a live but closed-loop trust-beneficiary claim, and its lending service creates a separate unsecured repayment claim against SBI VC Trade outside customer-asset segregation. DCJPY remains issuing-bank deposit money; retail CBDC and tokenized BOJ reserves remain pilots. BOJ-NET remains the decisive wholesale yen-finality point unless a later legal and technical record proves otherwise.

authority.summary: The Diet and Cabinet define the legal perimeter; the FSA supervises cryptoasset, electronic-payment-instrument and banking actors and now convenes the interministerial On-Chain Finance Forum; the BOJ operates central-bank settlement and retail- and wholesale-money experiments; MOF owns sovereign-debt questions and retains a role with the Diet in any future retail-CBDC constitution.
authority.boundary: Supervision, system operation, pilot work and sovereign issuance authority are different capacities.

legal_objects.summary: The existing research separates cryptoassets, fiat-backed electronic payment instruments, specified-trust beneficiary stablecoins, bank-issued tokenized deposits and a possible retail CBDC. Their debtor, backing and protection rules differ even when all are yen-denominated or tokenized.
legal_objects.boundary: Token form and yen denomination do not make unlike legal claims interchangeable.

permitted_activities.summary: Registered or otherwise eligible entities can conduct the activities allowed by their exact cryptoasset, electronic-payment-instrument, trust, banking or payment status. JPYSC issuance, distribution, custody, redemption and consumption-loan lending are separate activities; the lending contract is not customer-asset safekeeping. DCJPY bank-deposit issuance, PIP participation and CBDC experimentation remain distinct.
permitted_activities.boundary: A firm's permission for one object or activity is not a universal digital-money license.

entry_gates.summary: At cutoff the FSA listed 27 cryptoasset exchange providers and two electronic-payment-instrument service providers. SBI VC Trade is registered for USDC, RLUSD and JPYSC; Coincheck's 27 August registration covers USDC. JPYSC access and direct redemption require identity, legality, wallet and bank-account checks; bank-issued tokenized deposits remain issuer and customer specific.
entry_gates.boundary: A register entry confirms the named provider and described statutory object; it is not an issuer licence, value guarantee, recommendation, product launch or complete customer-access record.

named_operating_actors.summary: The national record identifies the FSA, BOJ, MOF, DICJ, BOJ-NET, Zengin-Net, JSCC, SBI Shinsei Trust Bank, SBI VC Trade, Coincheck, DeCurret DCP, GMO Aozora Net Bank, TradeWaltz, the three megabank groups and participating banking groups in distinct roles. XRP Asia now lists Tokyo as a community node. It is a regional ecosystem-support body, not SBI Ripple Asia, a Japanese regulated provider or a bank settlement operator.
named_operating_actors.boundary: Group affiliation, platform participation and technical integration do not merge the underlying legal entities or their balance sheets.

claims_and_backing.summary: JPYSC is a specified-trust beneficiary claim backed by trust assets and is neither legal tender, a bank deposit nor deposit-insured. The 30 June snapshot disclosed ¥10,008,294,794 issued and ¥10,008,304,794 in the trust's deposit account. When a customer lends JPYSC to SBI VC Trade, that customer instead holds an unsecured consumption-loan repayment claim outside customer-asset segregation. DCJPY is an issuing-bank deposit backed by the bank's balance sheet. A future retail CBDC or tokenized BOJ current-account balance would be a BOJ claim only if legally and operationally issued.
claims_and_backing.boundary: Trust segregation, an intermediary loan claim, commercial-bank deposit insurance and a direct central-bank liability are different protections and failure paths.

domestic_rails.summary: BOJ-NET supplies wholesale yen finality; Zengin combines large-value RTGS, small-value deferred net settlement and extended-hours customer credit; securities and collateral routes use JASDEC, JSCC and BOJ-NET endpoints. PIP-3 is comparing interbank tokenized-deposit accounts with a stablecoin bridge, and the BOJ DLT sandbox is testing tokenized current-account money or connectivity, but neither has displaced the authoritative incumbent records.
domestic_rails.boundary: Customer credit, token-platform state, clearing, securities title and central-bank cash finality can occur on different clocks.

cross_border_routes.summary: Japan participates in Project Agorá and Swift tokenized cross-border work, and PIP-4 will test connecting TradeWaltz trade documents to a future three-megabank stablecoin. The Indonesia-Japan QR linkage is a distinct production account-money route. None of the tokenized records yet establishes a recurring cross-border corridor, uniform finality or terminal-loss rule.
cross_border_routes.boundary: A controlled test, pioneer program and production QR payment link are different systems and operating states.

operating_state.summary: JPYSC and its lending service are live but closed-loop; DCJPY has completed narrow production and controlled field tests; Coincheck's electronic-payment-instrument registration does not by itself prove product launch; retail CBDC and tokenized BOJ current-account money remain experiments; the forum, TradeWaltz PIP-4, three-megabank stablecoin, multi-bank tokenized-deposit bridge, Agorá and Swift work remain coordination, planned or test states. XRP Asia's Tokyo community listing is live organizational infrastructure, not a Japanese financial product or transaction.
operating_state.boundary: Live product, narrow production, completed test, planned launch and pilot are not synonyms.

scale.summary: JPYSC disclosed ¥10.008294794 billion issued and ¥10.008304794 billion in its deposit backing account at 30 June; the multi-bank tokenized-deposit experiment had 43 interested regional and other banks by August; the FSA lists 27 crypto exchanges and two electronic-payment-instrument intermediaries. These are different measures and do not show open-wallet circulation, nationwide transaction frequency, market share or systemic scale.
scale.boundary: Issued balance, participant count, transaction notional, circulation and required persistent token inventory are separate measurements.

stress.summary: Public evidence does not establish JPYSC redemption performance under reserve-market stress, DCJPY issuer failure during a locked transaction, or cross-border platform divergence under production load.
stress.boundary: Contractual controls, reserve rules and simulations are not observed stress evidence.

correction_and_loss.summary: BOJ-NET finality limits reversal but does not eliminate later compensation or restitution. Ordinary JPYSC follows trust assets and redemption law with no deposit insurance; lent JPYSC follows SBI VC Trade's consumption-loan obligation and can be lost in its insolvency because the units are outside customer-asset segregation. DCJPY follows the issuing bank's deposit and resolution regime if its stated classification governs; future retail or wholesale CBDC loss and reversal rules remain undecided.
correction_and_loss.boundary: Liquidity support, operational continuity, deposit protection, trust segregation, intermediary lending and terminal loss absorption are different mechanisms.

evidence_boundary.summary: The completed September 14 Japan Monetary Constitution remains the deeper owner. The October recertification adds the forum and roadmap, Coincheck registration, PIP-4, exact JPYSC scale, lending-loss transformation, 43-bank experiment population and BOJ wholesale sandbox. The 3 October XRP Asia delta adds a Tokyo ecosystem-support node while preserving the separate SBI Ripple Asia, provider, permission and settlement records. Open questions include current reserve composition, open-wallet use, selected cross-bank settlement model, production cross-border reversal and observed digital-claim failure.
evidence_boundary.boundary: Later product, reserve, rulebook, transaction and failure evidence may change this normalized projection without superseding the deeper owner.
